answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened to Mount Seir beyond its location: it was given to Esau, its earlier people were destroyed, and its inhabitants were later slain.

clauses.english: was given by the LORD to Esau for a possession
clauses.quote: I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession

clauses.english: was taken from the Horites when the children of Esau destroyed them
clauses.quote: the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them

clauses.english: had its inhabitants destroyed by Ammon and Moab
clauses.quote: stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them

doubts: Ezekiel 35's pronouncement of desolation was left out as a prophecy rather than an event.
Verses where Seir means the people or the land generally (GEN 32:3, 2CH 25:11) were not used.
